analysis: one-sided empirical Bernstein lower bound for paired context means in [-1,1]; held only if the lower bound exceeds 0.05
direction: two fixed support observations minus none is positive
extension: no result-dependent extension, replacement or new seed; incomplete packet remains incomplete
multiplicity: 0.025 reserves familywise 0.05 for at most two final primaries; an unselected second contrast remains probability one and cannot replace this result
primary_estimand: equal-weight mean across fresh seven-part structural/acquisition contexts of the within-context four-history success fraction with two fixed support observations minus no added observation
projection_scope: uses discovery mean and context-paired sample variance only to choose a fixed untouched allocation; the final decision uses fresh observations
secondary: held-out legality probability-error reduction and the public-candidate-union direct rival are descriptive boundary measures, not replacement primaries
unit: fresh law/task/acquisition context; four histories nested
